item.title: On-Time Performance Is Becoming an Airline Marketing Weapon
item.description: Airlines that treat punctuality as an operating identity rather than a one-year PR win are turning on-time performance into a durable marketing advantage.

item.title: Kasa Acquires Mint House in Bet After Silver Lake’s Backing
item.description: Kasa's takeover of Mint House creates the largest U.S. manager of apartment hotels after a wave of failures in the U.S. segment.

item.title: Radisson Hires for Net Zero Manager as it Expands Climate Efforts
item.description: As building emissions rules tighten and financing remains a challenge, hotel groups may increasingly need in-house expertise to manage carbon data, owners, and compliance.

item.title: Airbnb Hires Former Meta AI Chief Ahmad Al-Dahle as CTO
item.description: By hiring Meta’s former generative AI chief as CTO, Airbnb showed that AI is no longer a side project — and underscored online travel’s competition for Big Tech talent.

item.title: When Scrapers Get Scraped: eDreams Moves Against Tryp.com in Prime Fare Dispute
item.description: When online travel agencies can't get permission to access a major airline's flights, particularly its lowest fares, they often engage in cat-and-mouse game to get them. The outcome can have dire consequences for smaller OTAs, and adversely impact the larger ones, as well.

item.title: Marriott Deepens Saudi Arabia Push With 2,700-Room Deal
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s tourism ambitions won’t be won by trophy hotels. Marriott’s midscale-heavy deal shows a belief that filling rooms, not adding gold bling, will determine whether the kingdom's tourism development goals succeed.

item.title: U.S. Suspends Immigrant Visa Processing From 75 Countries
item.description: Entering the U.S. continues to get harder for people from much of the world.

item.title: Airbnb’s Chesky on AI Cutting Jobs: ‘Not as Much as I Thought’
item.description: While competitors cite AI efficiency as a reason to cut staff, Brian Chesky argues that faster growth will absorb the gains. At least for now.

item.title: Soho House Saves Go-Private Deal With Last-Minute Funding
item.description: Better late than never: Soho House has secured $200 million in alternative financing after an earlier effort failed. It aims to close its go-private deal by January 31.

item.title: Bangladesh Cuts India Visa Services While Sri Lanka, Nepal Court Its Travelers
item.description: The world may be looking to get more Indian travelers, but not every country is keen on it, even if India is a low-hanging fruit sitting right beside it.
